method: Retrospective independent packet timing from the post-ServerHello client TLS request record to the first client FIN/RST; ordered fixture log identifies encrypted paths. Negative control delays a close by six seconds and recomputes the capture digest.
limitations: Retrospective verification of the earlier experimental package, not a fresh exact-candidate replay.
TLS request paths are encrypted; stream-to-path mapping comes from the fixture's ordered hit log.
Packet captures cover the fixture network namespace, not host-client or other-tool traffic.
The finite close observations do not establish universal socket-leak freedom.
